rules.requirement: A landlord cannot ask about your criminal record until after a conditional offer, and must disclose its criminal-history screening in writing before taking an application fee. After an offer only recent or serious convictions count, with lookbacks of 6 years (1st degree), 4 years (2nd/3rd) and 1 year (4th). rules.requirement: A security deposit may not exceed 1.5 times one month's rent, and yearly increases may not exceed 10% of the current deposit.
